hexbingo.hex.scope_1.name: Utility Scope
hexbingo.hex.scope_1.desc: Gain +1 block interaction range and +1 entity interaction range.

hexbingo.hex.scope_3.name: Greatest Utility Scope
hexbingo.hex.scope_3.desc: Gain +3 block interaction range and +3 entity interaction range.
hexbingo.hex.prismatic_shift.name: Prismatic Ascension
hexbingo.hex.bees.name: Little Bees
hexbingo.hex.bees.desc: Summon 10 angry bees around every enemy team. Bees can sting through invulnerability.
hexbingo.hex.gold_rush.name: Gold Rush
hexbingo.hex.gold_rush.desc: Attacking a mob grants 1-3 gold nuggets, 5s cooldown per mob.
hexbingo.hex.ascension.name: Ascension Ritual
hexbingo.hex.ascension.desc: Killing a hostile mob grants a random buff.
hexbingo.hex.still_water.name: Still Water Prison
hexbingo.hex.still_water.desc: All players can no longer receive any hex rewards.
hexbingo.hex.pandora.name: Pandora's Box
hexbingo.hex.pandora.desc: Reroll all of your current hexes.
hexbingo.hex.homeguard.name: Homeguard
hexbingo.hex.homeguard.desc: Gain speed while running continuously; each 10s raises the speed level. Stop for 0.2s and it fades. Max Speed IV.
hexbingo.hex.gluttonous_feast.name: Gluttonous Feast
hexbingo.hex.gluttonous_feast.desc: Permanently gain Hunger II. Eating any food grants a random level II buff for 15s.
hexbingo.hex.goliath.name: Goliath
hexbingo.hex.goliath.desc: Gain +30% size, max health, block break speed and attack damage.
hexbingo.hex.untouchable.name: You Cannot Touch Me
hexbingo.hex.untouchable.desc: Right-click the skill item: enemy Bingo teams cannot break blocks for 30s. 5 minute cooldown.
hexbingo.hex.stack_dragon.name: Stack Dragon
hexbingo.hex.stack_dragon.desc: Each mob kill adds a stack; every 15 stacks grants a loot chest. Higher stacks mean better loot.
hexbingo.hex.glass_cannon_bag.name: Glass Cannon Bag
hexbingo.hex.glass_cannon_bag.desc: The last 18 inventory slots are filled with barrier markers (items are moved out or dropped). Item drops are doubled.
hexbingo.hex.back_to_basics.name: Back to Basics
hexbingo.hex.back_to_basics.desc: You cannot use a crafting table, but item drops are doubled (boosted by Looting) and you gain permanent Speed I.
hexbingo.hex.archmage.name: Archmage
hexbingo.hex.archmage.desc: After crafting, each material has a 10% chance to be refunded.
hexbingo.hex.lone_hero.name: Lone Hero
hexbingo.hex.lone_hero.desc: Plays the song and grants a random permanent buff.
hexbingo.hex.dechi_song.name: Dechi Song
hexbingo.hex.dechi_song.desc: Plays the villager version of the Dechi song; grants random Luck III-V during it, and all pickaxes in your inventory gain Fortune II-III.
hexbingo.hex.utopia.name: Utopia
hexbingo.hex.utopia.desc: Scrambles all your potion effects and grants 5 new permanent random buffs or debuffs.
hexbingo.hex.dash_charge.name: Rush Rush Rush
hexbingo.hex.dash_charge.desc: Gain "Rush Rush Rush": right-click to automatically dash forward for 8 seconds (no forward key needed), steering with your view. Blocks in a 3x3 area along the way are broken and drop (except obsidian and bedrock), and creatures hit take 10 damage. 15 second cooldown after the dash ends.
hexbingo.hex.sheep_wool.name: Sheep Sheep Sheep
hexbingo.hex.sheep_wool.desc: Killing a sheep additionally drops 2 wool of random colors.
hexbingo.hex.portable_bench.name: Portable Workbench
hexbingo.hex.portable_bench.desc: Gain "Portable Workbench": right-click to open a 3x3 crafting grid without placing a crafting table.
hexbingo.hex.soul_out.name: Soul Out
hexbingo.hex.soul_out.desc: Immediately enter spectator mode for 30 seconds to scout freely, then return to the position where you entered spectator mode.
hexbingo.hex.bone_meal_spray.name: Growth Spray
hexbingo.hex.bone_meal_spray.desc: Every 10 seconds, sprinkles bone meal on crops and plants within a 9 block radius, randomly growing up to 12 of them.
hexbingo.hex.task_copy.name: CV Engineer
hexbingo.hex.task_copy.desc: Randomly copies a task an opponent has completed but your team has not; in Lockout mode, directly claims that slot instead.
hexbingo.hex.big_brain.name: Big Brain
hexbingo.hex.big_brain.desc: All your inventory items become random items for 5s, then are restored.
hexbingo.hex.inventor.name: Inventor
hexbingo.hex.inventor.desc: Tools, weapons and armor you craft in the future gain random enchantments.
hexbingo.hex.pet_master.name: Pet Master
hexbingo.hex.pet_master.desc: Gain an invincible pet that gives you a random item from the full item pool every 8s (valuable items are rarer).
hexbingo.hex.crown_me_king.name: Crown Me King
hexbingo.hex.crown_me_king.desc: A beacon marks an enemy position. Reach it to gain a prismatic hex, a randomly enchanted diamond armor set, an Efficiency IV diamond pickaxe and a Sharpness IV / Fire Aspect I diamond sword.
hexbingo.hex.hook_dizzy.name: Hook Dizzy
hexbingo.hex.hook_dizzy.desc: Unlocks /bingo hook: pull yourself toward the block you are looking at. 5s cooldown.
hexbingo.hex.flip_table.name: Flip the Table!
hexbingo.hex.flip_table.desc: Reroll every task that no team has completed.
hexbingo.hex.flip_table_one.name: Flip the Table?
hexbingo.hex.flip_table_one.desc: Reroll one task that no team has completed yet.
hexbingo.hex.boomerang_biome.name: Boomerang OK
hexbingo.hex.boomerang_biome.desc: Gain a boomerang that flies toward an unfinished biome task and returns.
hexbingo.hex.rainbow_duel.name: Trapped With Me
hexbingo.hex.rainbow_duel.desc: Gain a bound chain. Right-click to enter a bedrock duel with the nearest enemy; PvP is allowed, whoever dies first loses, the winner leaves at once, and both leave after 5 minutes without PvP. 3 minute cooldown.
hexbingo.hex.fae_magic.name: Fey Magic
hexbingo.hex.fae_magic.desc: Gain Fey Magic: right-click to turn the enemy team into critters for 1 minute. 5 minute cooldown.
hexbingo.hex.pearl_stock.name: Pearl Stock
hexbingo.hex.pearl_stock.desc: Gain 8 ender pearls and 2 blaze powder.
hexbingo.hex.chinese_can_fly.name: Chinese Can Fly
hexbingo.hex.chinese_can_fly.desc: Gain an unbreakable elytra and one bound firework rocket that is always replenished.
hexbingo.hex.spy.name: Spy
hexbingo.hex.spy.desc: Use /bingo spy <teammate> <enemy> to swap their positions and inventories. Bound items stay with their owner. Once per game.
hexbingo.hex.soul_bomb.name: Soul Bomb
hexbingo.hex.soul_bomb.desc: Gain 3 soul sand, 2 wither skeleton skulls and 1 flint and steel.
hexbingo.hex.practice_day.name: Practice Day
hexbingo.hex.nether_start.name: Breaking Into Hell
hexbingo.hex.nether_start.desc: Immediately sent to the Nether; /tp, /bp and /bingo tp are disabled until you return to the Overworld.
hexbingo.hex.star_voyage.name: Star Voyage
hexbingo.hex.star_voyage.desc: Teleported to Y=256 with a platform and a water bucket. You MUST land in water or you will die. Landing safely unlocks 1 random Bingo slot.
hexbingo.hex.swap_tasks.name: Perspective Swap
hexbingo.hex.swap_tasks.desc: Randomly swap the positions of two tasks on the current Bingo card.
hexbingo.hex.mushroom_scout.name: Swift Scout
hexbingo.hex.mushroom_scout.desc: Random mushrooms (including nether fungi) grow in a 3 block radius around you.
hexbingo.hex.wormhole.name: Wormhole
hexbingo.hex.wormhole.desc: Instantly teleport to a random spot 1-1000 blocks away.
hexbingo.hex.cat_cult.name: Flying Cat Cult
hexbingo.hex.cat_cult.desc: Summon every cat variant around you.
hexbingo.hex.dog_squad.name: Dog Squad
hexbingo.hex.dog_squad.desc: Summon every wolf variant around you.
hexbingo.hex.jam_bp.name: Out of Service
hexbingo.hex.jam_bp.desc: Gain Out of Service: right-click to disable enemy /bp for 3 minutes. 9 minute cooldown.
hexbingo.hex.sand_gold.name: Gold Rush
hexbingo.hex.sand_gold.desc: Mining sand has a 3% chance to drop a gold nugget.
hexbingo.hex.eye_taxi.name: Eye Taxi
hexbingo.hex.eye_taxi.desc: Your thrown eyes of ender no longer shatter.
hexbingo.hex.flowers_walk.name: Flowers on the Way
hexbingo.hex.flowers_walk.desc: Flowers grow on grass blocks you walk over.
hexbingo.hex.forge_master.name: Forge Master
hexbingo.hex.forge_master.desc: Replace the tools and weapons in your inventory with random tiers of the same type.
hexbingo.hex.village_road.name: All Roads Lead to Rome
hexbingo.hex.travel_frog.name: Travel Frog
hexbingo.hex.travel_frog.desc: Summon a frog; right-click it with half a stack of food for a random structure map (shipwreck / End ruin / woodland mansion / village / ancient city / pillager outpost / desert pyramid / jungle temple; in the Nether: bastion / fortress / ruined portal).
hexbingo.hex.random_bingo.name: Whatever
hexbingo.hex.random_bingo.desc: Gives you a random bingo (completed ones included).
hexbingo.hex.love_tribute.name: Tribute to Love
hexbingo.hex.ruined_portal.name: Nether Start
hexbingo.hex.ruined_portal.desc: Teleport to the nearest ruined portal.
hexbingo.hex.ancient_ruins.name: Ancient Ruins
hexbingo.hex.ancient_ruins.desc: Randomly spawn 4-15 suspicious gravel or suspicious sand near you.
hexbingo.hex.amnesia.name: Amnesia
hexbingo.hex.amnesia.desc: Randomly revert one completed Bingo task of another team.
hexbingo.hex.ice_boots.name: Ice!
hexbingo.hex.ice_boots.desc: Gain Frost Walker II diamond boots.
hexbingo.hex.snow_pumpkin.name: Snow Golem Society
hexbingo.hex.snow_pumpkin.desc: Put cursed carved pumpkins on all enemy players; they cannot be removed by yourself — a teammate must right-click you with shears. A solo player can sneak-right-click with shears.
hexbingo.hex.pokemon_master.name: Pokemon Master
hexbingo.hex.raven_mouth.name: Raven Mouth
hexbingo.hex.raven_mouth.desc: Summon a black parrot; it randomly reverts one of your completed tasks or completes one random task.
hexbingo.hex.friends_here.name: Trapped With Friends
hexbingo.hex.friends_here.desc: Each nearby teammate grants +2% speed and Haste I (max +10%).
hexbingo.hex.common_wealth.name: Common Wealth
hexbingo.hex.common_wealth.desc: Confiscate everyone's inventory items into a common pool, then redistribute them randomly.
hexbingo.hex.chaos_shift.name: Chaos Shift
hexbingo.hex.chaos_shift.desc: Gain two random hexes of random colors.
hexbingo.hex.village_hero.name: Village Hero
hexbingo.hex.village_hero.desc: Gain Hero of the Village I permanently.
hexbingo.hex.immunity_shield.name: Immunity Shield
hexbingo.hex.immunity_shield.desc: Every 60 seconds, become immune to the next skill-type hex from an opponent.
hexbingo.hex.seed_gift.name: Seed Pack
hexbingo.hex.seed_gift.desc: Gain 1-8 each of random wheat, carrot, potato, beetroot, melon, and pumpkin seeds.
hexbingo.hex.archaeology_brush.name: Archaeology Brush
hexbingo.hex.archaeology_brush.desc: Gain a brush that never loses durability.
hexbingo.hex.jump_tiger.name: Jumping Tiger
hexbingo.hex.eighty_one_trials.name: Eighty-One Trials
hexbingo.hex.eighty_one_trials.desc: Teleport to the nearest trial chambers.
hexbingo.msg.seed_gift: Seed Pack: received %s seeds in total.
hexbingo.msg.brush_gift: You received a brush that never loses durability.
hexbingo.msg.immunity_shield: Immunity Shield: block one opponent skill every 60 seconds.

hexbingo.msg.shield_spy: The target's Immunity Shield blocked the spy swap.

hexbingo.hex.inventory_shuffle.desc: Right-click the skill item: randomly shuffle the inventory, offhand and armor slots of all enemy players (items may end up in equipment slots). 8 minute cooldown.
hexbingo.hex.nether_banish.name: Dimensional Banish
hexbingo.hex.nether_banish.desc: Banish one player from each enemy team to a random place in the Nether for 1 minute. Cooldown: 8 minutes.
hexbingo.hex.wildcard.name: Wildcard
hexbingo.hex.wildcard.desc: Randomly light up one cell on the Bingo card.
hexbingo.hex.the_world.name: The World!
hexbingo.hex.the_world.desc: Gain the "The World" time-stop skill; right-click to stop time for 8 seconds so only you can move. Cooldown: 3 minutes.
hexbingo.msg.day_night: Day and night flipped; time will not change naturally for 10 minutes.
hexbingo.msg.inventory_shuffle: Chaos Mind: shuffled the inventories of %s enemy players.
hexbingo.msg.inventory_shuffled: Chaos Mind: your inventory, offhand and armor slots were shuffled!
hexbingo.msg.chaos_mind_none: Chaos Mind: no enemy players to affect.
hexbingo.item.banish.lore: Right-click: banish one player from each enemy team to the Nether for 1 minute.
hexbingo.msg.banish_item: You received "Dimensional Banish"; right-click to use it.
hexbingo.msg.banish_cooldown: Dimensional Banish is on cooldown: %s s.
hexbingo.msg.banish_cast: Dimensional Banish: sent %s players to the Nether.
hexbingo.msg.banished: You were banished to the Nether; returning in 1 minute.
hexbingo.msg.banish_return: Banish ended; returned to your previous position.
hexbingo.msg.banish_no_tp: While banished, you cannot use teleport commands in the Nether!
hexbingo.msg.wildcard_all: Wildcard lit up "%s"; every team gets this cell.
hexbingo.msg.wildcard_done: Wildcard landed on the already completed "%s".
hexbingo.msg.the_world: The World!: other players are frozen for 8 seconds.
hexbingo.msg.the_world_target: Time stopped for 8 seconds; you cannot move!
hexbingo.msg.world_item: You received the "The World" time-stop skill; right-click to use it.
hexbingo.msg.world_cooldown: The World is on cooldown: %s s.
hexbingo.hex.corrupt_inventory.name: Corrupt Backpacks
hexbingo.hex.corrupt_inventory.desc: For every team except yours, 5 random items of one random player turn into rotten flesh.
hexbingo.hex.black_market.name: Black Market
hexbingo.hex.black_market.desc: The next time you open a villager trade screen, that villager reaches max level and you gain Hero of the Village II permanently.
hexbingo.hex.demon_pact.name: Demon Pact
hexbingo.hex.demon_pact.desc: Permanently lose 10 max health, but you can take damage; gain a full set of randomly enchanted iron armor and immediately complete the highest-weight Bingo task.
hexbingo.msg.corrupt_inventory: Corrupt Backpacks: corrupted the items of %s enemy players.
hexbingo.msg.corrupted: Corrupt Backpacks: 5 of your items turned into rotten flesh!
hexbingo.msg.black_market: Black Market: the next villager you trade with will reach max level.
hexbingo.msg.black_market_used: Black Market: that villager reached max level; you gained Hero of the Village II.

hexbingo.msg.demon_pact_none: Demon Pact: no task available to complete.
hexbingo.hex.spider_man.name: Spider Man
hexbingo.hex.spider_man.desc: Climb walls like a spider (only full-collision blocks). Press V to toggle.
hexbingo.hex.magnet.name: Magnet
hexbingo.hex.magnet.desc: All dropped items within 16 blocks fly toward you.
hexbingo.hex.dice_roll.name: 3-Sided Die
hexbingo.hex.dice_roll.desc: Every 5 minutes roll a d6: above 3 grants Speed II for 4 minutes, below 3 grants Slowness I for 4 minutes, and 3 roots you for 6 seconds.
hexbingo.hex.toolbox.name: Toolbox
hexbingo.hex.toolbox.desc: Gain 1 random crafting table, furnace, anvil, grindstone or stonecutter.
hexbingo.msg.dice_speed: Dice roll %s: Speed II for 4 minutes.
hexbingo.msg.dice_slow: Dice roll %s: Slowness I for 4 minutes.
hexbingo.msg.dice_lock: Dice roll 3: you are rooted for 6 seconds.
hexbingo.hex.louis_xvi.name: Louis XVI
hexbingo.hex.louis_xvi.desc: The first mob you kill is guaranteed to drop 1 of its heads.
hexbingo.hex.airdrop.name: Delivery Arrived
hexbingo.hex.airdrop.desc: Airdrop a chest above you filled with loot from a random vanilla chest loot table.
hexbingo.hex.sea_god.name: Sea God
hexbingo.hex.sea_god.desc: Gain an enchanted trident (Loyalty III, Channeling I, Mending I) that returns when thrown.
hexbingo.hex.totem_bulk.name: Totem Wholesale
hexbingo.hex.totem_bulk.desc: Gain 3 Totems of Undying. While holding one, you can take damage, so the 'Postmortal' advancement can be completed.
hexbingo.msg.louis_xvi_none: Louis XVI: this mob has no head.
hexbingo.msg.louis_xvi_ready: Louis XVI: your next kill will drop its head.
hexbingo.msg.airdrop: Delivery Arrived: a loot chest airdropped above you.
hexbingo.msg.sea_god: Sea God: received an enchanted trident.
hexbingo.item.sea_god.lore: Loyalty III, Channeling I, Mending I; returns when thrown.
hexbingo.msg.totem_bulk: Totem Wholesale: received 3 Totems of Undying.
hexbingo.hex.ender_slayer.name: Ender Slayer
hexbingo.hex.ender_slayer.desc: Killing an Enderman has a 1% chance to drop an enchanted book: Silk Touch I, Mending I or Infinity I.
hexbingo.hex.ultimate_refresh.name: Ultimate Refresh
hexbingo.hex.ultimate_refresh.desc: Your next hex selection can be refreshed one extra time, and you immediately gain 2 loot chests.
hexbingo.msg.ender_slayer: Ender Slayer: the Enderman dropped an enchanted book (%s).
hexbingo.msg.ultimate_refresh: Ultimate Refresh: gained 2 loot chests; you can refresh once during your next selection.
hexbingo.msg.demon_pact_armor: Demon Pact: gained a full set of randomly enchanted iron armor.
hexbingo.msg.dash_blocked: Dash Charge: blocked by obsidian or bedrock, dash interrupted.
hexbingo.hex.dolphin_dash.name: Fish God
hexbingo.hex.dolphin_dash.desc: Gain permanent Dolphin's Grace II while in water.
hexbingo.hex.portable_furnace.name: Portable Furnace
hexbingo.hex.portable_furnace.desc: Gain 'Portable Furnace': right-click to open a furnace screen anywhere. Its smelting speed is affected by Smelting Speed.
hexbingo.hex.smelt_speed.name: Smelting Speed
hexbingo.hex.smelt_speed.desc: Furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers smelt twice as fast.
hexbingo.item.portable_furnace.lore: Right-click to open a furnace screen.
hexbingo.msg.portable_furnace_item: You received 'Portable Furnace': right-click to open it.
hexbingo.hex.meteor.name: Meteor
hexbingo.hex.meteor.desc: Average the positions of all teams and call down 5-10 amethyst meteors of varying size. Enemy players have a 10x10 area under their feet shattered and get Slowness III, and you receive a map marking every impact point.
hexbingo.hex.offer_upgrade.name: Quality Upgrade
hexbingo.hex.offer_upgrade.desc: Your next hex selection is guaranteed to contain at least 1 prismatic hex. Only offered during the first hex selection.
hexbingo.hex.blind.name: Blind
hexbingo.hex.blind.desc: Gain 'Blind'. Right-click to blind all enemies for 8 seconds. Cooldown 3 minutes.
hexbingo.hex.is_it_over.name: Is It Over?
hexbingo.hex.is_it_over.desc: Teleport to the End outer islands for 10 minutes. You cannot be teleported by anything during this time, and you return automatically when it ends.
hexbingo.hex.auto_smelt.name: Auto Smelt
hexbingo.hex.auto_smelt.desc: Mining ores automatically smelts the drops and grants extra experience.
hexbingo.hex.task_shield.name: Task Shield
hexbingo.hex.task_shield.desc: Lock your team's 3 highest-weight tasks so other hexes cannot push them back.
hexbingo.hex.midas_touch.name: Midas Touch
hexbingo.hex.midas_touch.desc: Press G to turn your offhand item into the same amount of gold ingots (valuables excluded). Cooldown 1 minute.
hexbingo.hex.bat_form.name: Bat Form
hexbingo.hex.bat_form.desc: Gain 'Bat Form'. Right-click to become a real bat for 60 seconds: you turn invisible and shrink to 0.5 blocks tall while a real bat follows you; flight, no attacks, reduced health. Cooldown 7 minutes.
hexbingo.hex.mind_control.name: Mind Control
hexbingo.hex.mind_control.desc: Gain 'Mind Control'. Right-click to control one enemy's movement direction for 15 seconds. Cooldown 5 minutes.
hexbingo.hex.objective_deny.name: Objective Deny
hexbingo.hex.objective_deny.desc: Gain 'Objective Deny'. Right-click and pick a task; no team can complete it for 30 seconds. Cooldown 15 minutes.
hexbingo.hex.xray.name: X-Ray
hexbingo.hex.xray.desc: Gain 'Ore Vision'. Right-click for 20 seconds of ore x-ray. Cooldown 5 minutes.
hexbingo.hex.scavenger.name: Scavenger
hexbingo.hex.scavenger.desc: Breaking blocks has a 3% chance to drop the block itself as an extra drop.
hexbingo.hex.card_shuffle.name: Card Shuffle
hexbingo.hex.card_shuffle.desc: Randomly rearrange every team's card positions; completion and lock states follow their tasks.
hexbingo.hex.mirror_hex.name: Mirror Hex
hexbingo.hex.mirror_hex.desc: Gain 'Mirror Hex'. Right-click to copy one hex you do not own from the nearest other team (opens a selection list). Single use: the item disappears after use.

hexbingo.hex.gaze_abyss.name: Gaze Into the Abyss
hexbingo.hex.gaze_abyss.desc: Teleport to the nearest deep dark biome and find a safe spot inside its caves.
hexbingo.msg.gaze_abyss: Gaze Into the Abyss: teleported to the nearest deep dark biome.
hexbingo.msg.gaze_abyss_none: Gaze Into the Abyss: no deep dark biome found nearby.
hexbingo.hex.cutting_edge.name: Cutting Edge Inventor
hexbingo.hex.cutting_edge.desc: All skill-type hex cooldowns are reduced by 30%.
hexbingo.msg.cutting_edge: Cutting Edge Inventor: your skill hex cooldowns are 30% shorter.
